part: SQUATCHEE-SPIN retainer v3 (PLA or PETG) — rigid mini-squatchee twist-lock cap with journal sleeve
notes: v3: the retainer is RIGID again ('all materials work' is back - no flexing feature anywhere) and locks with a push-and-twist BAYONET instead of a snap. The sleeve (OD 6.6, wall 0.8 - the journal the prop spins on, unchanged D7.2/D6.6 pivot contract) carries two L-windows: a vertical entry channel (2.0 wide, through the rim, model z3.9-7.1) and a 34-deg circumferential pocket (z3.9-6.05), leaving a 0.95-tall solid ledge ring segment at the rim end.
